remarks: Seller will consider an interest rate buy-down! Experience contemporary architectural luxury in this West Coast–inspired masterpiece, perfectly sited on a private 1+ acre wooded lot just outside the iconic Village of East Aurora. Framed by scenic agricultural and equestrian views, this home pairs retreat-style privacy with seamless proximity to top-rated schools, shopping, dining, and major thoroughfares. Upon entering, beautiful blonde oak floors flow throughout the main living spaces into a soaring great room, where 25-foot ceilings and massive banks of windows flood the floor plan with natural light. The adjoining gourmet kitchen blends high-end contemporary design with warm traditional accents, featuring rich dark cabinetry, custom slatted-wood details, premium brass hardware, gourmet appliances, and a large center island. Just off the main living area, sliding glass doors lead out to an elevated, covered concrete patio that overlooks the secluded, wooded backyard and peaceful walking paths to the adjacent stream. The main-floor primary bedroom retreat is designed for relaxation, boasting vaulted ceilings, abundant natural light, a custom accent wall, and a spa-inspired ensuite bathroom. Inside the bathroom, rich porcelain tile surrounds an expansive open shower, a freestanding soaking tub, and a custom furniture-style dual vanity with brass fixtures. For maximum convenience, the primary bath connects directly to a generous walk-through closet and a dedicated first-floor mud/laundry room with tiled pet shower.  Upstairs, two unique bedrooms showcase individual accent walls and a custom sliding door that opens to overlook the great room below. A beautifully-appointed, three-piece bathroom completes the second floor. The finished lower level offers an exceptional entertaining or work space complete with separate garage entrance, custom bar, feature lighting and plumbing fixtures, textural accents, and a private guest bedroom suite that is simply spectacular. Rounding out this remarkable property is an attached, heated 2.5-car garage with modern glass-paneled accent doors, along with an epoxy garage floor and lower level entrance.
